description: Independent bounded tests and metamorphic laws for binary_search
forward: Accept iff all specified finite assertions hold.
inverse: Let F be the explicit finite fixture set below, O(f) the oracle expectations and U the candidate implementations paired with pass/fail observations over F. R(P,pass) iff every assertion succeeds under the fixed execution assumptions. U minus R consists of false pass observations for any mismatch and false failure observations when every assertion holds. Conditional exact harness model; panics count as failures, harness crashes/timeouts are outside this two-outcome universe.

Given a failing fixture and observed mismatch, retain all candidate implementations whose observations violate that assertion. Wrong tie policy, wrong bounds, wrong arithmetic and fixture-oracle defects may share the same failure. Passing admits every implementation agreeing on this finite F and leaves all off-fixture behavior unconstrained; no unique fault reconstruction.
limitations: Finite acceptance does not prove general correctness; source-bound partial AST omits macro expansion and semantic typing.
